pa78552b911.notes: Night shot of a shopping-centre facade (Tunis); target is the small red Polaris store panel at lower left. Its tagline is illegible. Distractors: vertical red 'MONO...' sign (rest unreadable), partly hidden lower fascia with Latin/Arabic lettering, camper van in foreground.

c107985887.reason: traffic stop sign ('قف / STOP'), no place name

c15286913.reason: not a sign: museum photo of a Punic stele (Tophet of Carthage) on black background, photographed in the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Lyon, France

c18892096.notes: Free-standing wayfinding totem inside the amphitheatre of El Jem, angled to the camera. Header (with UNESCO World Heritage emblem) names the site in small type; the large text is the direction to the tiers, with a left arrow. A scratch runs through 'مدارج' and 'GRADINS', letters intact. The amphitheatre plan and tiny 'Vous êtes ici / You are here' labels at the bottom are not transcribed.

c36867691.notes: National Heritage Institute glass plaque on the medina wall of Monastir (Commons title: Beb Brikcha sign). The printed film is peeling, so the ministry and institute names (top left 'المعهد الوطني للتراث / Institut National du Patrimoine', top right ministry line) are partly lost and not transcribed; the 'Patrimoine National / تراث وطني' logo text is also skipped. The bottom Arabic line ('معلم مرتب: أمر 218 بتاريخ', classified monument: decree 218 dated) is not transcribed separately. Sun and shadow fall across the plaque.

c37130852.notes: Stone mosaic name panel of the Tunisian Academy (Carthage), frontal; tree shadow over the upper-left corner. French only on this panel.

c55909149.notes: Blue enamel medina street plate (Tunis), seen from slightly below. The Arabic is in a cursive Maghrebi hand: the last word ends in a long stroke with an upturned hook and no visible dots, so it is transcribed نجمه, although the Commons title spells it نجمة; a small mark above its first letter may be a damma. Checker please confirm the last letter. A chip in the enamel crosses the U of RUE.

c99787718.notes: Free-standing white 3-D letters with a red heart in front of a whitewashed shop window in Tozeur; the heart is a shape, written here as ♥. Strong lens flare streak across the left part. Distractor: 'Boulangerie Pâtisserie Ben Bder' fascia at left (partly cut off). Borderline: a city-love sign rather than a name board, but it names the town.

f0be62acd-426c-436e-a917-52ff633c3592.notes: Pharmacy in Sousse: green rooftop letters (script 'Pharmacie' + Arabic) and two green awnings with the name in French and Arabic. Distractors at right: 'عالم النظارات / Mondial Optic' rooftop sign, 'OPTICIEN / Adaptation de lentilles de contact' and 'نظارات طبية' awnings with a phone number. Parked cars in the foreground are incidental. Source is 1024 px.

f4ab54bff-500a-4495-99ba-8f4e8f424a0d.notes: Stack of four white arrow panels at night (Port El Kantaoui), lit by flash/street light; Tunis and Hergla to the right, Sousse and Hammam Sousse to the left. Any panel name is a valid place query. Car light trails in the background.

c166762266.notes: Painted ceramic-tile street plate with floral corners on a brick wall, Tozeur medina; one upper tile is missing but the name is complete. No 'نهج' prefix on this plate.

c162807347.notes: Ceramic-tile street plate, Tozeur; surname written 'لعجيمي' (colloquial, not 'العجيمي'). Tiny maker's signature in the bottom-left corner tile is not part of the label.

c15364097.notes: Name board over the souk gate, Nabeul. Distractors: hanging 'La Vieille Ville / The Old Town / Der Alt Stadt' sign and a dense Arabic restoration-project plaque (Tunisian Republic, Nabeul medina association, T. TELECOM / ONAS / SONED / STEG).

c10054286.notes: Hand-painted red sign over a public letter-writer's door, Douz (photographed in 2002; the file is a scan of the photographer's own colour print, not a document). Calligraphic Arabic: the first word joins 'بن يحي' into one word 'بنيحي'. The Latin is hand-lettered with a rounded 'E' and the word 'PUBLIC' is set lower than 'ECRIVAIN'; inkwell-and-quill drawings in the corners.

c47706623.notes: Painted lettering on the facade of a public bathhouse, Place Sidi El Bahri, Tunis; 1280 px image. Arabic is split across the arches (حمّام right, الصّيودة left) with small shadda marks over م and ص. A pedestrian partly overlaps the 'BA' of BAIN; parked vans in front, one with Tunisie Telecom 'TT' branding (distractor).

c56647800.notes: Carpet shop fascia in Kairouan with a tiled minaret motif between the French and Arabic panels. Distractors: 'Artisanal' tile sign at left, Office National de l'Artisanat 'Magasin recommandé' plaque at upper right.

c107985885.notes: Black direction sign with a left-pointing arrow containing a mosque pictogram, Djerba. Faint black marker graffiti scribbled over the black background is a distractor and not part of the label.
